svg.title: udfx project architecture
svg.desc: A Python UDF and input schema enter the shared udfx compiler. It traces Python, builds udfx IR, and lowers expressions through a Polars, DuckDB, Apache DataFusion, or Apache Spark adapter. The resulting expression runs in the user's dataframe query. Rows use native execution where it matches Python and the original Python function otherwise.

g.font-family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, sans-serif
g.text: Pass a function, column types, and a backend to udfx.compile.
Rows where native results match Python
